name: Alice in Stardom
source:
Alice just wanted to get through her internship- but when a contestant drops right before the first episode of the idol contest she's working at, she's forced into the stage light. Can she make it to the top or will she be eliminated?

[from [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/alice-in-stardom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝只是想完成她的实习，但当一名参赛者在她正在参加的偶像大赛第一集开始前退出时，她被迫出现在舞台灯光下。她能否登上巅峰，还是会被淘汰？

[来自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/alice-in-stardom]itch.io[/url]]
